review_notes: I read the whole file. It has four lemmas and no definitions, structures or classes. It adds no new notion that competes with an existing one. It only states small lemmas about the existing `NeZero` class and `Nat.cast`. Lean core already has `NeZero.ne` and `Nat.pos_of_neZero`. `NeZero.pos_of_neZero_natCast` (used in `Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomial/Cyclotomic/Roots.lean`) is a distinct lemma about casts into an `AddMonoidWithOne`. `NeZero.natCast_ne` only restates `NeZero.ne` for a cast. `NeZero.one_le` could overlap with `Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero` or `Nat.pos_of_neZero`. Those would count as standalone theorem duplication or proof shortening, which the rubric excludes. I found no competing concept to consolidate.
